hooks.command: SESSION=$(tmux display-message -p '#{session_name}' 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown') && MSG=$(jq -r '.message') && terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -subtitle "Session: $SESSION" -message "$MSG" -contentImage ~/.claude/claude-logo.png -sound Glass -group "claude-$SESSION"

SESSION=$(tmux display-message -p '#{session_name}' 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown') && WINDOW=$(tmux display-message -p '#{window_index}' 2>/dev/null || echo '0') && WNAME=$(tmux display-message -p '#{window_name}' 2>/dev/null || echo 'claude') && MSG=$(jq -r '.message') && terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -subtitle "Session: $SESSION" -message "$MSG" -contentImage ~/.claude/claude-logo.png -sound Glass -group "claude-$SESSION" && ~/.tmux/scripts/log-alert.sh "$SESSION" "$WINDOW" "$WNAME" CLAUDE

SESSION=$(tmux display-message -p '#{session_name}' 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown') && WINDOW=$(tmux display-message -p '#{window_index}' 2>/dev/null || echo '0') && WNAME=$(tmux display-message -p '#{window_name}' 2>/dev/null || echo 'claude') && terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -subtitle "Session: $SESSION" -message 'Claude finished' -contentImage ~/.claude/claude-logo.png -sound Glass -group "claude-$SESSION" && ~/.tmux/scripts/log-alert.sh "$SESSION" "$WINDOW" "$WNAME" CLAUDE

statusLine.command: jq -r '[ .model.display_name, "ctx:\(.context_window.used_percentage // 0)%", (if .worktree.name then "wt:\(.worktree.name)" else null end), (if .worktree.branch then "br:\(.worktree.branch)" else null end), (if .rate_limits.five_hour then "5h:\(.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage | round)%" else null end), (if .rate_limits.seven_day then "7d:\(.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage | round)%" else null end) ] | map(select(. != null)) | join("  |  ")'
